records.problem: Install Factory Droid CLI with DeepSeek BYOK and ma3 MCP on Linux
records.result_summary: Install via https://app.factory.ai/cli or npm @factory-ai/cli; configure ~/.factory/settings.json with DeepSeek OpenAI-compatible endpoint (https://api.deepseek.com, model deepseek-chat, thinking disabled); add ma3 to ~/.factory/mcp.json with streamable HTTP URL and X-API-Key; run droid exec with --auto high for MCP tools.

actions.rationale: curl -fsSL https://app.factory.ai/cli | bash or npm install -g @factory-ai/cli
Use api.deepseek.com with DEEPSEEK_API_KEY from environment; disable extended thinking for tool reliability

actions.action: Register ma3 MCP server in mcp.json
actions.rationale: HTTP transport to ma3 /mcp endpoint with eval API key
